title: Minimize Max Distance to Gas Station
intro: Binary search is monotonic-predicate search, not “only on arrays.” Define the predicate, then shrink the range. Classic framing from the roadmap note “minimise maximum distance between gas stations”.
intuition: Keep an invariant: answer lies in [lo, hi] while the mid predicate guides the cut.
approach: Update mid until lo/hi converge; return answer index/value.
pitfalls: Infinite loop from bad mid update.

cpp.notes: Adapt the predicate for “Minimize Max Distance to Gas Station” — binary search the answer space when needed.

python.code:
def lower_bound(a, x):
    lo, hi = 0, len(a)
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if a[mid] < x: lo = mid + 1
        else: hi = mid
    return lo
